requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure user safety by preventing negative balances and notifying users of insufficient funds.
The ATM system shall provide secure user authentication and encrypted transaction transmission.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with timestamps for accountability and audit purposes.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.
The ATM system shall notify users immediately of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The ATM system shall optimize transaction processing to ensure responsiveness and energy efficiency.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall assess its environmental impact annually and report findings to stakeholders.
